program_dir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            if value != 0:
                counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            points = [(r+dr, c+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(rr < h and cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == 0 for rr, cc in points):
                for rr, cc in points:
                    out[rr][cc] = marker
    return out
'''
